title: A planted redaction check puts one fake secret in every field the output prints, not only in commands and text
goal: the sprint skill's plan step 6 tells the planner that a check proving a display or output is redacted plants a fake secret in every field that output prints (names, paths, inputs, results, labels), not only in a command and a text

run:
import re,sys
t=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
s=t.split('## plan',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0]
step=[p for p in re.split(r'\n(?=\d+\. )',s) if p.startswith('6. ')]
sys.exit(0 if step and re.search('every field',step[0],re.I) else 1)
